title: Meta Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): META Falls 3.3% to $737.54
summary: Meta (META) fell 3.27% to $737.54 on Oct 14 after a Guggenheim analyst lifted his 2027 capex estimate to $225 billion, amid a broad tech selloff.
body_markdown:
## Why Meta Stock Fell


As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/meta-stocks-fall-3-7-191705385.html) , the decline followed a note from Guggenheim analyst Michael Morris, cited by Barron's, who raised his 2027 capital spending estimate for Meta to $225 billion from $203 billion. GuruFocus stressed that the figure is Morris's own estimate and not company guidance.


The estimate lands well above Meta's own plan. According to the company's[second quarter 2026 results filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001326801/000162828026050596/meta-06302026xexhibit991.htm) , Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion and full-year total expenses of $165 billion to $169 billion.


Spending was also in focus after comments from Mark Zuckerberg. Per[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/mark-zuckerberg-defends-metas-ai-173015808.html) , Zuckerberg said on a podcast that Meta was ready to "write this check for, like, I don't know, like $100 billion, $200 billion" on AI infrastructure, arguing the buildout would "position the company to really lead in the area for decades to come."


## META Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Meta's second quarter revenue grew 28% to $60.80 billion, with ad impressions up 14% and average ad prices up 12%, according to GuruFocus.
- Zuckerberg said Meta plans to make its Muse models self-funding through premium consumer subscriptions and "business in a box" tools for small businesses, per Benzinga.
- Deepwater's Gene Munster argued that the Muse personal AI agent could challenge Google search in purchases and bookings, as reported by[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/gene-munster-flags-meta-muse-213359454.html) , a view on Meta's reach against[Alphabet (GOOGL)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/googl/) .


### Risks


- Operating income fell 8% to $18.78 billion in the second quarter as costs rose, GuruFocus reported.
- Zuckerberg put the upfront cost of a 1 gigawatt data center at $50 billion to $60 billion and its yearly running cost at about $15 billion, per Benzinga, while Meta plans to scale its Louisiana cluster to 5 gigawatts.
- Higher outside spending estimates, such as Guggenheim's $225 billion figure for 2027, could keep pressure on margins if revenue growth slows.
